name: third-party.native-debug
description: Curated provider manifest for the native.debug capability.

source.upstreamOwner: LLDB, GDB and platform debugger maintainers
source.upstreamSource: debug-lldb, LLDB, GDB and platform-native debugger tooling

native.debug.fallback: Manual log collection, crash reports, thread dumps and platform debugger steps run by the user.

install.method: Use platform debugger tooling already available for the project or install the relevant debugger through trusted system channels.
uninstall: Remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set; uninstall debugger tooling through the platform package manager if needed.

permissions.approval: Human approval required before attaching to a process, escalating privileges or reading sensitive process memory.

transport.notes: Platform-local debugger commands; no network transport required by this wrapper.

security.notes: Native debugging can inspect process memory and require elevated privileges. Attach and privilege changes require human approval.

risk.notes: Debugger attachment can expose secrets in memory, pause processes or require elevated OS permissions.
